Load packages and read in files
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(vegan)

# Read file
folder <- "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/coverm_65"

files <- list.files(
  path = folder,
  pattern = "\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {

  dat <- read.delim(
    f,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Expected order:
  # Genome, Mean, Relative Abundance (%), Covered Fraction
  dat <- dat[, 1:4]

  colnames(dat) <- c(
    "Genome",
    "Mean",
    "Relative_Abundance",
    "Covered_Fraction"
  )

  dat
})

names(data_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files))

all_data <- bind_rows(data_list, .id = "Culture") %>%
  mutate(
    Culture = sub("^coverm_", "", Culture)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^unmapped$", Genome, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

```



Include genus
```{r}
gtdb <- read.delim(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output/65MAGs/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

gtdb_clean <- gtdb %>%
  select(user_genome, classification) %>%
  separate(
    classification,
    into = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "class",
      "order",
      "family",
      "genus",
      "species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      domain:species,
      ~ sub("^[a-z]__", "", .)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = case_when(
      !is.na(genus) & genus != "" ~ genus,
      !is.na(family) & family != "" ~ paste0(family, " (family)"),
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    ),
    Phylum = case_when(
      !is.na(phylum) & phylum != "" ~ phylum,
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    user_genome,
    Genus,
    Phylum
  )

# Join GTDB taxonomy to each MAG
all_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(
    gtdb_clean,
    by = c("Genome" = "user_genome")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = coalesce(Genus, "Unclassified"),
    Phylum = coalesce(Phylum, "Unclassified"),
    Genus = recode(
      Genus,
      "JACDQM01" = "JACDQM01 (Kinneretia)"
    )
  )

```


Make csv
```{r}
write.csv(all_data, "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/supplemental/coverm65.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


Prep data for plotting
```{r}
culture_order <- c(
  "1025", "1026", "1027", "1029",
  "1030", "1031", "1032", "1033",
  "1801", "1802", "1803", "1804",
  "1805", "1806", "1807", "1808",
  "1809", "1810", "1811", "1812"
)

plot_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Culture = as.character(Culture)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Culture %in% culture_order
  ) %>%
  select(
    Genome,
    Genus,
    Phylum,
    Culture,
    Relative_Abundance
  )

# Keep individual MAGs whose maximum abundance
# reaches at least 1% in any culture
mags_to_plot <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    Max_Abundance = max(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Max_Abundance >= 1) %>%
  pull(Genome)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Genome %in% mags_to_plot)

# Order MAGs by their own median abundance
mag_order <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Abundance = median(
      Relative_Abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Median_Abundance), Genome) %>%
  pull(Genome)

# Genus label, while keeping Genome
# as the unique plotting identifier
mag_labels <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(Genome, Genus) %>%
  mutate(
    Label = Genus
  )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  left_join(
    mag_labels,
    by = c("Genome", "Genus")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Genome = factor(Genome, levels = mag_order)
  )

# Named label vector for the x-axis
axis_labels <- setNames(
  mag_labels$Label,
  mag_labels$Genome
)
```



Create abundance boxplots across cultures
```{r}
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Actinomycetota"  = "#7c6f64",
  "Bacteroidota"    = "#5b7694",
  "Cyanobacteriota" = "#52796f",
  "Pseudomonadota"  = "#b45f5a",
  "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56",
  "Unclassified"    = "#999999"
)

boxplot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Genome,
    y = Relative_Abundance,
    fill = Phylum
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = axis_labels
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = phylum_colors,
    na.value = "#999999"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genus of each MAG",
    y = "MAG Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill = "Phylum"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

boxplot
```

Is there a difference among the 65 MAGs across cultures
```{r}
# Make stat data frame
stat_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Culture = factor(Culture),
    Genome = factor(Genome)
  ) %>%
  filter(Culture %in% culture_order) %>%
  select(Culture, Genome, Genus, Relative_Abundance)

# How much does each MAG vary between cultures
mag_variation <- stat_data %>%
  group_by(Genome, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean = mean(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```



```{r}
# Save
write.csv(
  mag_variation,
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/supplemental/MAG_abundance_variation.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


Bray-Curtis dissimilarity of MAG communities
```{r}
# Create culture x MAG relative abundance matrix
mag_matrix <- all_data %>%
  mutate(Culture = as.character(Culture)) %>%
  filter(Culture %in% culture_order) %>%
  select(Culture, Genome, Relative_Abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Genome,
    values_from = Relative_Abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Put cultures in desired order
mag_matrix <- mag_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    Culture = factor(Culture, levels = culture_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Culture)

# Save culture names
culture_names <- as.character(mag_matrix$Culture)

# Convert abundance columns to numeric matrix
mag_abundance_matrix <- mag_matrix %>%
  select(-Culture) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(mag_abundance_matrix) <- culture_names

# Calculate Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
bray_mag <- vegdist(
  mag_abundance_matrix,
  method = "bray"
)

# PERMANOVA

# Create grouping factor for isolation year
isolation_year <- ifelse(
  grepl("^10", rownames(mag_abundance_matrix)),
  "10xx",
  "18xx"
)

isolation_year <- factor(isolation_year)

# Check sample assignments
data.frame(
  Culture = rownames(mag_abundance_matrix),
  Isolation_Year = isolation_year
)

# Run PERMANOVA
set.seed(42)

permanova_mag <- adonis2(
  bray_mag ~ isolation_year,
  permutations = 999
)

permanova_mag
```



```{r}
# Principal Coordinates Analysis
pcoa_mag <- cmdscale(
  bray_mag,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE,
  add = TRUE
)

# Extract coordinates
pcoa_data <- data.frame(
  Culture = rownames(pcoa_mag$points),
  PCoA1 = pcoa_mag$points[, 1],
  PCoA2 = pcoa_mag$points[, 2]
)

# Percentage variation represented by each PCoA axis
positive_eig <- pcoa_mag$eig[pcoa_mag$eig > 0]

variance_explained <- positive_eig / sum(positive_eig) * 100

PCoA1_percent <- round(variance_explained[1], 1)
PCoA2_percent <- round(variance_explained[2], 1)

PCoA1_percent
PCoA2_percent

# Plot
pcoa_plot <- ggplot(
  pcoa_data,
  aes(
    x = PCoA1,
    y = PCoA2
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Culture),
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", PCoA1_percent, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", PCoA2_percent, "%)"),
    color = "Isolation Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

pcoa_plot
```



```{r}
ggsave(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/supplemental/PCoA_MAG_CoverM.svg",
  plot = pcoa_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)
```

Pairwise MAG abundance correlations
```{r}
# Make sure all MAG abundance columns are numeric
mag_abundance_matrix[] <- lapply(
  mag_abundance_matrix,
  as.numeric
)

# Get MAG names
mag_names <- colnames(mag_abundance_matrix)

# Create all unique pairs of MAGs
mag_pairs <- combn(
  mag_names,
  2,
  simplify = FALSE
)

# Run Spearman correlation for every MAG pair
correlation_results <- lapply(
  mag_pairs,
  function(pair) {
    
    x <- mag_abundance_matrix[[pair[1]]]
    y <- mag_abundance_matrix[[pair[2]]]
    
    # Spearman correlation
    test <- cor.test(
      x,
      y,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    data.frame(
      MAG1 = pair[1],
      MAG2 = pair[2],
      Rho = unname(test$estimate),
      P_value = test$p.value
    )
  }
)

# Combine results into one dataframe
correlation_results <- bind_rows(correlation_results)

# Correct for multiple comparisons using
# Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate
correlation_results <- correlation_results %>%
  mutate(
    P_adjusted = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

# Sort by adjusted p-value
correlation_results <- correlation_results %>%
  arrange(P_adjusted)

# Check number of pairwise comparisons
nrow(correlation_results)

# Summarize correlation coefficients
summary(correlation_results$Rho)

# Summarize adjusted p-values
summary(correlation_results$P_adjusted)

# Identify correlations significant after BH correction
significant_correlations <- correlation_results %>%
  filter(P_adjusted < 0.05)

# Number of significant correlations
nrow(significant_correlations)

# Add direction
significant_correlations <- significant_correlations %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = case_when(
      Rho > 0 ~ "Positive",
      Rho < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(P_adjusted)

# View results
significant_correlations

# How many significant positive and negative correlations?
table(significant_correlations$Direction)

significant_correlations

# Create MAG-to-genus lookup table
mag_taxonomy <- all_data %>%
  select(Genome, Genus) %>%
  distinct()

# Add genus identity for both MAGs
significant_correlations <- significant_correlations %>%
  left_join(
    mag_taxonomy,
    by = c("MAG1" = "Genome")
  ) %>%
  rename(Genus1 = Genus) %>%
  
  left_join(
    mag_taxonomy,
    by = c("MAG2" = "Genome")
  ) %>%
  rename(Genus2 = Genus) %>%
  
  select(
    MAG1,
    Genus1,
    MAG2,
    Genus2,
    Rho,
    P_value,
    P_adjusted,
    Direction
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Rho)))


```
